remarks: Best and Final offers requested by Monday 12pm. Welcome to easy, convenient living in the heart of Stamford! This well-maintained 1-bedroom, 1-bath first-floor condo offers the perfect blend of comfort, functionality, and location. Featuring beautiful bamboo flooring, Corian countertops, and an abundance of closet space and storage throughout, this home is designed for both everyday living and effortless organization. The bright and inviting layout includes heat, hot water, and cooking gas in the common charges-adding exceptional value and convenience. Enjoy the ease of first-floor living along with a dedicated parking spot ideally located close to the unit. Situated in a highly desirable Stamford location, you'll love being just minutes from shopping, dining, transportation, downtown Stamford, and everything the area has to offer. Whether you're a first-time buyer, downsizer, or investor, this move-in ready condo is an opportunity you won't want to miss!
